[center]Feathery, white - maybe not sterile, but… maybe it is? That’s the vibe I was going for with this pack. I’m really happy with how it turned out, and I hope you find the furniture useful.[/center]

[list]
[*]Q: When will you release PC's Victorian Furniture?
A: It's still in the works! The furniture count is already quite big, but I want it to be even bigger :p so it’s taking a bit of time.
[*]Q: I have the most recent Nexus version of the mod, but SMAPI keeps telling me to update.
A: That’s on my end. Sometimes I publish an update without updating the version number in the manifest.json. You can safely open the manifest.json file with a text editor and update the version number manually.
[/list]
